summary: Roof-It, Inc. (saltlakecityroofs.com) shows a strong offline reputation (4.9, 245 reviews) and claimed profile with online estimates offered, but the site has clear, fixable website opportunities. Deterministic audit (Opportunity Score 59, Confidence 88) flags Content hierarchy as main issue: The homepage does not use one clear primary heading. Measured signals confirm this with accessibility and SEO gaps addressable without rebuild.

topOpportunities.title: Fix homepage heading hierarchy (7 H1s)
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage H1 count: 7 - deterministic finding: The homepage does not use one clear primary heading.
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Multiple H1s dilute topical focus and screen-reader navigation. A single clear hierarchy could help both SEO clarity and accessibility without changing design.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Consolidate to one H1 that matches primary intent (e.g., Roofing Contractors in Salt Lake City, UT) and convert other 6 H1s to H2/H3 in logical outline. Verify in crawl after change.

topOpportunities.title: Complete image alternative text
topOpportunities.evidence: Image alt-text coverage: 23% across 22 images on homepage
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Low coverage contributes to Accessibility 65 and limits image search relevance. Improving alt text is a low-effort accessibility and SEO win.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to the ~17 images missing it, prioritizing service/before-after and hero images. Keep decorative images with empty alt="".

topOpportunities.title: Add structured data on homepage
topOpportunities.evidence: Structured data: not found and JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0 and hasSchema false
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: No schema limits eligibility for enhanced search results. For a Developing digital maturity (score 48) business with no structured data points, this is a foundational fix.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add JSON-LD LocalBusiness/RoofingContractor schema with name, address 3424 W 2400 S Ste B, West Valley City, UT 84119, phone, areaServed, and sameAs links. Validate with Google Rich Results Test.

topOpportunities.title: Repair broken link and add canonical
topOpportunities.evidence: Broken internal links: 1 of 6 checked (https://saltlakecityroofs.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection returned HTTP 404)
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: One broken link of six degrades crawl quality and user experience, noted as Page crawl warnings: 1. Canonical false may affect duplicate handling for / and /home-8981 which share title and wordCount 2458.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix or remove the broken email-protection link and re-check all 6 internal links. Also investigate why Canonical URL: not found to ensure proper canonical tag on homepage.
